program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (has-cell? cell cells)
      (any? (lambda (p) (and (= (fst p) (fst cell)) (= (snd p) (snd cell)))) cells))
    (let* ((objs
             (sort
               (objects g 0)
               (lambda (a b)
                 (let ((sa (obj-size a))
                       (sb (obj-size b))
                       (ba (obj-bbox a))
                       (bb (obj-bbox b)))
                   (or (< sa sb)
                       (and (= sa sb)
                            (or (< (first ba) (first bb))
                                (and (= (first ba) (first bb))
                                     (< (second ba) (second bb))))))))))
           (target (first objs))
           (cells (normalize-cells (obj-cells target)))
           (out-h (+ (max-list (map fst cells)) 1))
           (out-w (+ (max-list (map snd cells)) 1))
           (color (obj-color target)))
      (grid-from-fn out-h out-w
        (lambda (r c)
          (if (has-cell? (list r c) cells) color 0))))))
